K: Espresso, vanilla ice cream, milk and caramel, topped with cream and gummy worms

Espresso blended thick with vanilla ice cream, milk and a little caramel, topped with cream and gummy worms on the rim. Brew 4 espressos and cool for 10 minutes. Blend with 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 300ml cold milk and 2 tbsp caramel sauce until thick and smooth. Whip 300ml thickened cream to soft peaks. Pour the shakes into 4 tall glasses, top with the cream and drizzle with a little more caramel. Hang 2 gummy worms over each rim.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 230C with a tray inside.
Roll out the dough on a floured bench and cut into rounds.
Spread each round with sauce, then add mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni.
Bake on the hot tray until the bases are crisp and the cheese bubbles.
Brown the butter in a pan and leave to cool.
Beat the cooled butter with the sugar and egg, then mix in the flour and bicarb.
Roll into balls and place on lined trays.
Bake at 180C until set.
Cool the cookies on a rack.
Melt the chocolate and pipe pug faces on each cookie.
Heat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.
Stretch the dough thin into two bases and spread with salted crushed tomato.
Top with mozzarella and crumbled sausage meat, skins removed.
Bake each pizza at max heat until the crust blisters.
Mix the icing sugar, espresso and melted butter until smooth.
Dip the top of each doughnut in the icing.
Leave to set.
Brew the espressos and cool.
Blend with the ice cream, milk and some of the caramel until thick and smooth.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Pour into tall glasses, top with cream, drizzle with caramel and hang gummy worms over each rim.

edition.cue: Serve dinner when Frank the pug sings in the car.

s.how: Roll out 500g pizza dough and cut into 16 rounds. Spread each with a spoon of pizza sauce, then add grated mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Bake on a hot tray at 230C for 8 minutes until the bases are crisp and the cheese bubbles.

s.note: for Frank, who sings in the car
s.how: Brown 125g butter and cool. Beat with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 200g flour and half a tsp bicarb. Roll into 16 balls and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool, then pipe pug faces on with 50g melted dark chocolate.

m.how: Stretch 2 balls of cold-fermented dough, 500g in total, thin. Spread with 200g crushed tomato seasoned with salt. Top with 250g low-moisture mozzarella and 3 Italian sausages, skins off, crumbled. Bake on a steel at max heat for 7 minutes.

w.note: the worms live on coffee and doughnuts
w.how: Mix 200g icing sugar with 3 tbsp strong espresso and 10g melted butter until smooth. Dip the tops of 8 plain cake doughnuts and leave to set.

Pour the shakes into 4 tall glasses, top with the cream and drizzle with a little more caramel. Hang 2 gummy worms over each rim.
